scope: Product paragraph packer with explicit section boundaries; sparse only.
limitations: Abstract records cannot establish full-paper quality. Dense/hybrid unmeasured.

paired.interpretation: Query-paired descriptive bootstrap; failed, missing and undefined queries are counted separately, never silently scored as success. Small or repeatedly inspected sets do not establish general superiority. Draft labels are not human review.
